title: Newmark Arranges 15,000-Square-Foot Lease for Orthopedic and Physical Therapy Clinic in Northern California
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged a new 15,000-square-foot lease on behalf of Golden State Orthopedics & Spine at 2633 Camino Ramon in San Ramon, California.
